profile.headline: Software Engineer @Point72 | Interested in AI | Proficient in React, Typescript, Javascript, HTML, CSS & Java | Fintech
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Ever since I was a little kid, software development has been my passion. I still remember sitting in JAVA class for the first time in 8th grade, finding OOP concepts fascinating, and being proud of myself after successfully printing "Hello World." As I went through the JAVA class, it was almost magic, being able to get the computer to do whatever I wanted, just by typing in these funny little symbols, limited only by my imagination and ingenuity. Throughout high school, I latched on to any ideas for projects I could get, moving from "Hello World" to a simple Tower of Hanoi GUI game, with dozens of projects in between. I learned JAVA, followed by C and C++, tearing through any books I could find on anything remotely related to software development. I was insatiable.

 This passion carried me through my bachelor's at NMIMS followed by my master's at USC. Here there were more resources available to me than I ever could have imagined as a kid. I studied new languages, algorithms, compilers, higher mathematics, all with pretty much the same fascination that drove me as a kid. And it was here that I truly learned how much there was yet to learn.

 So, now, in industry, this passion remains with me. There is yet more to learn, yet more problems to solve, and yet more to build. And for this, I am very grateful.

Skills/Interests: Python, Java, JavaScript, Node, React, CSS, HTML, Git, SQL, Docker

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
As a front-end developer, I have been working on various projects involving Order Management Systems (OMS) for different clients. Currently, I am working on a custom OMS for a leading e-commerce company. My main responsibility is to build responsive, fast, and complex dashboards that update in real-time using StencilJs and Ramda. I also built a notification system that alerts the user of any changes or issues with the orders and allows them to take action accordingly.
Previously, I was part of the front-end team in a major project for one of the largest financial services providers. The project involved replacing their legacy Proprietary Order Management System (POMS) with a new one that improved the user experience and enabled fractional trading and other assets at scale.
Some of my achievements in this project were:
• Building a dynamic and high-performance admin UI dashboard that supported multi-user access and handled over 200k+ transactions using React, Typescript, and RxJs
• Writing comprehensive unit and end-to-end tests with 100% code coverage using Playwright
• Developing a highly customizable grid with resizing, reordering, and caching features using AgGrid
• Adopting a test-double architecture for testing that allowed parallel work with the backend API development using Hydra and StencilJS
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · TypeScript · Software Testing · React.js · Data Structures · Redux.js · Algorithms · RxJS · SQL · JavaScript · Front-End Development · Software Development

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
I worked on a mobile-friendly web and android app that helps parents manage their child’s phone usage.
Some of my achievements in this project were:
• Creating responsive dashboards using React, Node, and responsive web design practices that allow parents to create and manage tasks, rewards, and apps for their child’s phone. The dashboards achieved a 90% score on Lighthouse for performance and accessibility.
• Improving the offline usage of the android app by 15% by implementing caching and syncing mechanisms.
• Participating in peer code reviews and providing assistance in bug fixes and feature enhancements using Git and Jira.
• Optimizing the core front-end portal for better performance by reducing bundle size, implementing lazy loading, and using code-splitting techniques.
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · HTML · TypeScript · React.js · Data Structures · Redux.js · Algorithms · Android · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Mobile Applications · JavaScript · Front-End Development · Software Development

projects.title: Built Inverted Index using Hadoop cluster
projects.description:
Technologies used: JAVA, Hadoop MapReduce, GCP, AWS
- Developed a program in JAVA to build an Inverted Index using MapReduce for 74 files using GCP Dataproc
- Enhanced the application to generate an inverted index of bigrams instead of unigrams
- Executed the project on AWS using S3 buckets, EMR jobs, and EC2 instances

projects.title: Market Basket analysis and Recommendation using Spark
projects.description:
Technologies used:- Python, Scala & Apache Spark
- Programmed several algorithms like Apriori, LSH using Spark.
- Built model-based collaborative filtering(CF) & item-based CF models for recommendation.
- Achieved more than 50% run time performance improvement in Scala over Python implementation
